arrive.text: A runaway trolley. Left alone, it hits the five, and they stop it.

loop.text: Pull the lever, and it goes round the loop into him instead. He stops it, and it kills him, when he'd have been fine.

sign.text: The sign says: loop line. Rejoins main line.

pulled.text: He stopped it. The five are safe.

stayed.text: The five stopped it. He's safe.
